subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink market authorisation
what_would_settle_it: An ARPT licensing decision, a published authorisation register, or a ministerial statement on Starlink market entry.

subject: gov.discourse
name: Official explanation of the social-media restriction
what_would_settle_it: Any published legal basis, ARPT decision or ministerial statement acknowledging the restriction on Facebook, YouTube and TikTok.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Address register
what_would_settle_it: A national addressing instrument, a published address database or coverage figure, or the outcome of the digital addressing tender opened in November 2025.

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Artificial intelligence in the administration
what_would_settle_it: Any instrument governing or authorising AI use inside the administration, or a named system in production in a ministry.

subject: finance.sustain
name: FY2026 enacted budget, digital lines
what_would_settle_it: The 2026 initial finance law (Loi L/2026/010/CNT, March 2026), held in the catalogue, read into the budget extract; FY2026 has no folder.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: The end-of-year budget execution report or the loi de règlement for 2024 or 2025, giving execution against the digital lines, read into the budget extract.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Digital Compliance Fee and Digital Sovereignty Fund decree
what_would_settle_it: The text of the decree of 21 May 2026 creating the Digital Compliance Fee (RCN) and the Digital Sovereignty Fund (FSN), with the fund's governance and first-year receipts.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: Adoption of a public-data hosting or sovereign-cloud policy following the ANDE / Roland Berger study presented in May 2026, or the National Data Governance Strategy.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the Safe City and RNPP agreements
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the Safe City loan and Huawei implementation contract terms and of the ONECI-NG Tech Innovation memorandum.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Operator and operating terms of the national data centre
what_would_settle_it: A decision naming the operator of the Koloma national data centre and its management terms.
